description: This PHP source file defines the DAXClient class used for interacting with the Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) service as part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It primarily declares a class that extends the generic AwsClient, with docblock annotations detailing the available methods for managing DAX clusters and related resources.

classes.name: DAXClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) service, extending the general AWS client to include DAX-specific operations.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Initiates the creation of a new DAX cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new DAX cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing DAX cluster.

methods.name: describeClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata about DAX clusters.

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a DAX cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the configuration of a DAX cluster.
